Let's just go over notifications on Voat in their entirety. There are five ways to be pinged, and I'll break them into 3 sections:

  1. Receive a PM (a message in your inbox).

  2. Receive a reply to your submission or your comment.

  3. Get an "@" or "/u/" mention in a comment or submission.

  • The third way, through mentions, can only happen at the time the post is made. Editing a mention into a post or comment will not cause the user to be notified.

  • Mentions and replies are separate ways to trigger notifications. For example, when I type @X-Y here, you will now receive two notifications.

(To understand the last bullet point fully, this was received originally as a reply to a comment from @X-Y)

The point I think few may know is "Editing a mention into a post or comment will not cause the user to be notified."

Credit goes to @heygeorge for providing this info.
